sn4.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Uruvelāyaṃ viharati najjā Nerañjarāya tīre Ajapāla-nigrodha-mūle pathamābhisambuddho || 2.
sn4.1:1.3: Atha kho Bhagavato rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evam cetaso parivitakko udapādi || ||
sn4.1:1.5: sādhu mutto vatamhi tāya anattha-saṃhitāya dukkara-kārikāya ||
sn4.1:1.6: sādhu ṭhito sato bodhiṃ samajjhagan ti || 3.
sn4.1:2.1: Atha kho Māro pāpimā Bhagavato cetasā ceto-parivitakkam aññāya yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn4.1:4.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Māro ayam pāpimā iti viditvā Māram pāpimantam gāthāhi paccabhāsi || || Anattha-
sn4.1:7.1: Atha kho Māro pāpimā jānāti maṃ Bhagavā jānāti maṃ Sugato ti dukkhī dummano tatth-ev-antaradhāyīti || || 1.
